title: Exams don't mean zero touches
goal: Timely value for players/parents in exam season; positions Fluid as the planning experts

shots.vo: Exam season doesn't mean you stop touching a ball.
Twenty minutes, three times a week, is enough to hold your game.
Schedule it like a study block. Same time, every week.
Ten minutes of handles. Ten minutes of form shooting.
So when exams finish, you're not starting from zero.
